evidence.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 2012; entry credited to 胡偉
evidence.field: PDF p. 708, printed p. 695; 白部 entry; scan inspected
evidence.text: The entry says the graph’s construction is disputed and attributes the thumb pictograph account to Guo Moruo. It describes a sequence from oracle-bone to bronze, small-seal, and regular script forms. This verifies what the book reports; it does not establish the thumb as the graph’s original referent.
evidence.title: 字源, Volume 3

evidence.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 2012; entry credited to 胡偉
evidence.field: PDF p. 708, printed p. 695; 白部 entry; scan inspected
evidence.text: The entry presents a word-history proposal: the thumb account connects 白 with 伯 through the thumb’s supposed leading position, then treats use for the color word as borrowing. It says the color sense extends to purity; daylight motivates “bright,” which extends to clear or understood, then to state or argue a case, and to tell or report. It cites literary examples but supplies no dates for this proposed sequence.
evidence.title: 字源, Volume 3

evidence.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 2012; entry credited to 張標
evidence.field: PDF p. 301, printed p. 289; 白(自) entry; scan inspected
evidence.text: This is a separate headword 白(自), read zì, describing an alternate nose-pictograph form associated with 自. The entry says the forms were used for the same word in early writing and later became differentiated. It is not the 白 bái headword on printed page 695 and should not be merged with that entry.
evidence.title: 字源, Volume 3

evidence.source: 王寧, 復旦大學出土文獻與古文字研究中心
evidence.text: The 2010 article reports oracle-bone uses for the color word, 伯, and a place name; it surveys thumb, cloth, flame/light, face/head, and vessel proposals, rejects the thumb and face/head arguments as insufficient, and advances its own cooking or measuring vessel hypothesis. It proposes a specific sound relation between 鬴/釜 and 白—shared labial initial category and an 魚/鐸 rhyme correspondence—and on that basis treats color 白 and 伯 as loans. This is the author’s analysis, not independent confirmation of the vessel identification or its ancient name.
evidence.title: 王寧：再說“白”字之本義

evidence.source: 王寧, 復旦大學出土文獻與古文字研究中心
evidence.field: Attestation and limits on object identification
evidence.text: The article reports oracle-bone uses for 白 meaning white, 伯, and a place name, but gives no individually dated contexts establishing their order. It also says archaeological names assigned to uninscribed vessels cannot establish what Shang people called them. Thus the proposed sound relation does not independently recover the depicted object’s name or pronunciation.
evidence.title: 王寧：再說“白”字之本義

evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Chinese Character Structure Database
evidence.field: 伯字形演變; competing 白-to-伯 account
evidence.text: This entry proposes a thumb pictograph and a semantic path from the thumb’s leading position to 伯 as elder or leader; it says 白 was later borrowed for the color word and 人 was added to distinguish 伯. This is a source-specific account that conflicts with Wang Ning’s vessel proposal and loan analysis.
evidence.title: 漢字「伯」：字形演變

evidence.source: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Multi-function Chinese Character Database
evidence.field: 甲骨部件分析; reported uses of 白 and proposed relation to 百
evidence.text: The inspected entry attributes the thumb analysis to Guo Moruo and reports oracle-bone examples for 白 used as 伯 or a leader/title (合集36511), for the color word (合集30022 and 9177正), and for the number word 百 (合集1039). These are the database’s reported corpus references; I did not inspect the cited inscription facsimiles or independently date the examples. The entry presents competing accounts of 百’s graphic formation, so these reports do not establish a semantic development from “white” to “hundred.”
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：漢字甲骨部件分析

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary
evidence.text: The entry gives the reading bái and a literary reading bó. It lists the color sense and current senses including purity, brightness/daylight, clarity, telling or reporting, and figurative uses. This supports present-day and dictionary-recorded senses, not their historical derivation.
evidence.title: 白 : (語音) ㄅㄞˊ — 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》

evidence.source: William H. Baxter and Laurent Sagart
evidence.field: Old Chinese reconstruction table; 白 row
evidence.text: The authors identify the PDF as their 2014 Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese table and explain its notation. The extracted row for 白 with gloss “white” shows its GSR and dictionary-index fields but no readable Mandarin, Middle Chinese, or Old Chinese value in the opened table text. I therefore do not use this page to verify the dossier’s 白 reconstruction.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

gaps: The attached original scans were visually inspected: 字源 PDF p. 708 is printed p. 695 and contains the 白 bái entry; PDF p. 301 is printed p. 289 and contains the distinct 白(自) zì headword; PDF p. 709 is printed p. 696 and starts the following 白部 entries without continuing the prior quotation. The scan text on printed p. 695 ends at the bottom with the incomplete reference 《史記·滑稽列傳·西門》. This is printed in the scan, not an OCR substitution; do not infer the missing continuation or cite it as a complete passage.

No source-pixel transcription correction was identified for the 白 entry: the inspected scan agrees with the relevant OCR text, including the attribution of the thumb analysis and the described semantic extensions. No retired_evidence_ids are indicated.

The prior research gap saying Wang Ning gives no phonological argument should be revised: the inspected article does offer a proposed sound relation between 鬴/釜 and 白. It still does not independently establish the vessel’s Shang-era name or pronunciation, and its relation remains an attributed hypothesis. The dossier’s narrower claim that the object name is unrecovered remains supported.

No same-system Baxter–Sagart comparison could be verified for the proposed 鬴/釜-to-白 borrowing: the opened supplementary table search exposed no 鬴 or 釜 row, and its extracted 白 row had no readable reconstruction. The checkout also lacks the full sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv file; the supplied harness row and Mandarin bái from the Ministry dictionary are not substitutes for the missing matched historical rows.

The CUHK page reports oracle-bone corpus identifiers for 白 used as 伯, color 白, and 百, but those inscription witnesses were not independently inspected here and their dates/order are not established by this research. The graphic or semantic relationship between 白 and 百 remains disputed; avoid asserting a white-to-hundred semantic development.

The MOE dictionary confirms current readings and recorded senses, but its gloss list does not date their development. 字源 offers a proposed semantic chain for several senses without dating the transitions.

The early referent remains unresolved among conflicting proposals. The book attributes a thumb account to Guo Moruo; Academia Sinica presents that account, while Wang Ning argues for a vessel. These are source-specific analyses, not consensus.
